newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Sing signs US$300 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Dah Sing signs US$300 mln FRN.

text.p: Dah Sing Bank, an arm of Dah Sing Financial Holdings Ltd, said on Thursday it had signed its US$300 million mortgage-backed floating-rate notes (FRN).

"By removing selected mortgage loans from Dah Sing Bank's balance sheet, Dah Sing Bank will improve its capital efficiency, liquidity ratio and enable it to write new mortgage loans and expand or develop other business in Hong Kong," the bank said in a statement.
The FRNs was priced to float at 20 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, and had a legal maturity of 25 years.
Their anticipated average life was 2.67 years, with an expected final maturity at March 2004, assuming 25 percent constant prepayment rate for the underlying mortgage loans, it said.
Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday it has assigned its AAA rating to the notes.
